components.name: H1 Framed Folio Lockup
components.description: H1 Framed Folio mark (corner vault perimeter + sliding Viridian folio) paired with Option B Curio typography.
components.html: Curio
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #1C1A17; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-wordmark em { font-style: italic; }

components.name: Viridian Primary Pill
components.description: Human curation primary action (Immerse, Save Board, Open Exhibition).
components.css: .ds-btn-viridian { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #1B5E46; background: #1B5E46; color: #F2EFE9; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-viridian:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-viridian:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-viridian:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B5E46; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prussian MCP Scope Trigger
components.description: Dedicated Prussian/Cobalt technical indicator for active AI agent scopes.
components.css: .ds-mcp-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(27, 59, 111, 0.25); background: rgba(27, 59, 111, 0.09); color: #1B3B6F; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-mcp-pill:hover { background: rgba(27, 59, 111, 0.15); } .ds-mcp-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B3B6F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gallery Artifact Card
components.description: Elevated #FFFFFF card stock with 1px stone hairline and top catchlight.
components.html:
The Architecture of Happiness

Alain de Botton · 2006
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1C1A17; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.07); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #FFFFFF, 0 1px 2px rgba(24,22,18,0.05), 0 10px 26px -6px rgba(24,22,18,0.10); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); max-width: 260px; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2.5px); } .ds-card-media { height: 132px; background: #EAE5DC; } .ds-card-body { padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #686259; }

components.name: Universal Capture Omnibox
components.description: Single-row capture bar sitting inline inside the Curio masthead.
components.css: .ds-omnibox { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.09); border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px; } .ds-omnibox-input { width: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 9px 12px; color: #1C1A17; font-size: 14px; caret-color: #1B5E46; } .ds-omnibox-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B5E46; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview: Curio presents saved cultural objects, wardrobe pieces, household gear, private notes, and connected life records like curated artifacts mounted on warm gallery walls and housed inside dark bindery alcoves, unified by the H1 Framed Folio emblem and dual Viridian/Prussian registers.
keyCharacteristics: Elevated #FFFFFF gallery card stock over matte #F2EFE9 warm plaster (#1C1A17 over #121110 in dark mode).
Dual-register color discipline: Viridian Library (#1B5E46/#4CA382) for curation and Prussian/Cobalt (#1B3B6F/#6B93F5) for MCP agent scopes.
H1 Framed Folio identity mark with Option B Newsreader wordmark (solid o, italic r).
3-level navigation hierarchy (Top Boards -> Sub-Boards -> Contextual Filters) and automatic domain views.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Reserve saturated accent strictly for curation (Viridian) and MCP scopes (Prussian/Cobalt); never color-code categories.

rules.name: The Silent Spec Sheet Rule
rules.body: Never fabricate placeholder specs, dump internal ingestion keys inside cards, or place eyebrow kickers above headings.

rules.name: The Tactile Stock Rule
rules.body: Never nest bordered boxes inside bordered cards; let white stock over warm plaster establish separation.

dos: Do reserve Viridian (#1B5E46 / #4CA382) for human curation and Prussian/Cobalt (#1B3B6F / #6B93F5) for live MCP agent scopes.
Do route automatic views through resolveAutomaticBoardLayout() so recipes and purchased inventory never mount as 3D books.
Do use native <dialog> (showModal()), 100dvh units, overscroll-behavior-x: contain, and clamped { passive: true } scroll listeners.
donts: Don't render 'Bought it' or fabricated search footers on recipes, outfits, quotes, or memos.
Don't surface hidden Closet or Private Memos items when their Modular MCP domain scope is sealed.
Don't add role="dialog", aria-modal, <input type="range"> scrubbers, or hooks after conditional returns.
